summary: Customer is upset about an unexpected EMI increase.

intents.keywords: Your banks cheating me my EMI went up this ... nobody told me. Why is this happening?

issues.reason(s): Floating interest rate increased due to RBI's repo rate hike.

intents.actions of agent: Agent apologized, reviewed the loan account, explained the reason for the increase, and offered to explain the EMI calculation.
intents.Process Request: Escalate to supervisor and explore EMI moratorium option.
intents.resolution: Escalation to supervisor and exploration of EMI moratorium.

intents.keywords: This is nonsense. You should do won't me. I want ... speak to your manager.

issues.issue: Customer wants to speak to a manager.
issues.reason(s): Customer is dissatisfied with the explanation and wants further assistance.

intents.actions of agent: Agent agreed to escalate the issue to their supervisor.
